scope_items.item: When a tool raises an unexpected AttributeError, the client gets a short message naming the tool or action, with no exception class name or internal text
The same failure logs the exception details and traceback to stderr
The stderr log for a failure whose exception text includes an access key secret or session token does not contain that value
Errors that are already user-facing (validation, confirm=true, ClientError, WMCP-13 transport errors) reach the client unchanged
The change reuses the error helper from WMCP-13; the codebase has no second error-formatting helper
scope_items.evidence: src/wasabi_mcp/errors.py (extended in place), src/wasabi_mcp/server.py:43-73 (applied once in build_server)

scope_items.item: Apply the boundary once, centrally, in build_server with no tool module changes
Tests and a note in systemPatterns.md / docs

edge_cases.description: Async tools stay coroutine functions so the SDK awaits them
Tool input schemas unchanged after wrapping (functools.wraps / __wrapped__)
SDK does not log the raw exception via exc_info (our wrapper catches first)
Empty / unset configured credentials are skipped by redact
Tools registered other than via server.tool would bypass guard
